objectives.text: Authorize Federal Home Loan Banks to make secured advances to members and establish the collateral-eligibility categories and origination/renewal collateralization duty that govern such advances.

citations.quote: Each Federal Home Loan Bank is authorized to make secured advances to its members upon collateral sufficient, in the judgment of the Bank, to fully secure advances obtained from the Bank under this section or section 1431(g) of this title .
A Bank, at the time of origination or renewal of a loan or advance, shall obtain and maintain a security interest in collateral eligible pursuant to one or more of the following categories:

objectives.text: Establish that security interests granted to a Federal Home Loan Bank by a member (or affiliate) are entitled to priority over most other claimants' rights, notwithstanding other law, subject to two enumerated exceptions.

citations.quote: Notwithstanding any other provision of law, any security interest granted to a Federal Home Loan Bank by any member of any Federal Home Loan Bank or any affiliate of any such member shall be entitled to priority over the claims and rights of any party (including any receiver, conservator, trustee, or similar party having rights of a lien creditor) other than claims and rights that-

obligations.action: make secured advances to its members upon collateral sufficient, in the Bank's judgment, to fully secure advances obtained under this section or section 1431(g)
obligations.threshold: collateral sufficient, in the judgment of the Bank, to fully secure advances obtained from the Bank under this section or section 1431(g)

citations.quote: Each Federal Home Loan Bank is authorized to make secured advances to its members upon collateral sufficient, in the judgment of the Bank, to fully secure advances obtained from the Bank under this section or section 1431(g) of this title .

obligations.action: make a long-term advance only for the purposes of providing funds for residential housing finance or, for community financial institutions, for small businesses, small farms, small agri-businesses, and community development activities
obligations.trigger: the advance is a long-term advance

citations.quote: A long-term advance may only be made for the purposes of-
providing funds to any member for residential housing finance; and
providing funds to any community financial institution for small businesses, small farms, small agri-businesses, and community development activities.

obligations.action: obtain and maintain a security interest in collateral eligible pursuant to one or more of the categories set out in paragraph (3)
obligations.trigger: at the time of origination or renewal of a loan or advance

citations.quote: A Bank, at the time of origination or renewal of a loan or advance, shall obtain and maintain a security interest in collateral eligible pursuant to one or more of the following categories:

obligations.action: reduce its level of outstanding advances promptly and prudently in accordance with a schedule determined by the Federal home loan bank
obligations.trigger: the member has an advance secured by collateral the Bank determines is insufficient eligible collateral following renewal of a pre-August 9, 1989 advance

citations.quote: A member that has an advance secured by such insufficient eligible collateral must reduce its level of outstanding advances promptly and prudently in accordance with a schedule determined by the Federal home loan bank.

obligations.action: review the collateral standards applicable to each Federal home loan bank for classes of collateral in subparagraphs (D) and (E) of paragraph (3), and require an increase in those standards
obligations.trigger: if necessary for safety and soundness purposes

citations.quote: The Director may review the collateral standards applicable to each Federal home loan bank for the classes of collateral described in subparagraphs (D) and (E) of paragraph (3), and may, if necessary for safety and soundness purposes, require an increase in the collateral standards for any or all of those classes of collateral.

obligations.action: make, or cause or require to be made, such appraisals and other investigations as it deems necessary

citations.quote: each Home Loan Bank shall have power to make, or to cause or require to be made, such appraisals and other investigations as it may deem necessary.

obligations.action: accept a home mortgage otherwise eligible as collateral security for an advance
obligations.trigger: any director, officer, employee, attorney or agent of the Home Loan Bank or of the borrowing institution is personally liable on the mortgage
exceptions: unless the Director has specifically approved such acceptance

citations.quote: No home mortgage otherwise eligible to be accepted as collateral security for an advance by a Home Loan Bank shall be accepted if any director, officer, employee, attorney or agent of the Home Loan Bank or of the borrowing institution is personally liable thereon, unless the Director has specifically approved such acceptance.

obligations.action: hold a lien upon and hold the stock of the borrowing member as further collateral security for all indebtedness of the member to the Bank

citations.quote: the Federal Home Loan Bank shall have a lien upon and shall hold the stock of such member as further collateral security for all indebtedness of the member to the Federal Home Loan Bank.

obligations.action: enter into a primary and unconditional obligation to pay off all advances, together with interest and any unpaid costs and expenses, according to the terms under which they were made, in a form meeting the bank's requirements

citations.quote: The institution applying for an advance shall enter into a primary and unconditional obligation to pay off all advances, together with interest and any unpaid costs and expenses in connection therewith according to the terms under which they were made, in such form as shall meet the requirements of the bank.

obligations.action: require at any time, when deemed necessary for its protection, deposits of additional collateral security or substitutions of security by the borrowing institution
obligations.trigger: when deemed necessary for the Bank's protection

citations.quote: The bank shall reserve the right to require at any time, when deemed necessary for its protection, deposits of additional collateral security or substitutions of security by the borrowing institution,

obligations.trigger: when and as so required by the bank

citations.quote: each borrowing institution shall assign additional or substituted security when and as so required.

obligations.action: sell to any other Federal Home Loan Bank, with or without recourse, any advance made under the chapter, or allow such other bank a participation therein

citations.quote: Any Federal Home Loan Bank shall have power to sell to any other Federal Home Loan Bank, with or without recourse, any advance made under the provisions of this chapter, or to allow to such bank a participation therein,

obligations.action: make special liquidity advances subject to all applicable collateral requirements (including subsection (a)) and at an interest rate no less favorable than that for similar short-term liquidity advances to savings associations not presenting supervisory concern
obligations.trigger: a special liquidity advance is made pursuant to subsection (h)(1)

citations.quote: Any loan by a Federal Home Loan Bank pursuant to paragraph (1) shall be subject to all applicable collateral requirements, including the requirements of subsection (a), and shall be at an interest rate no less favorable than those made available for similar short-term liquidity advances to savings associations that do not present such supervisory concern.

obligations.action: make short-term liquidity advances to a savings association that is solvent but presents a supervisory concern and has reasonable and demonstrable prospects of returning to satisfactory financial condition
obligations.trigger: upon the request of the Director of the Office of Thrift Supervision
obligations.threshold: association is solvent but presents a supervisory concern because of poor financial condition, and has reasonable and demonstrable prospects of returning to satisfactory financial condition

citations.quote: the Federal Home Loan Banks may, upon the request of the Director of the Office of Thrift Supervision, make short-term liquidity advances to a savings association that-
is solvent but presents a supervisory concern because of such association's poor financial condition; and
has reasonable and demonstrable prospects of returning to a satisfactory financial condition.

definitions.definition: Collateral eligible pursuant to one or more of five categories: (A) fully disbursed, whole first mortgages on improved residential property (not more than 90 days delinquent), or securities representing a whole interest in such mortgages; (B) securities issued, insured, or guaranteed by the U.S. Government or an agency thereof; (C) cash or deposits of a Federal Home Loan Bank; (D) other real estate related collateral acceptable to the Bank with readily ascertainable value that the Bank can perfect an interest in; (E) secured loans for small business, agriculture, or community development activities (for community financial institutions).

citations.quote: A Bank, at the time of origination or renewal of a loan or advance, shall obtain and maintain a security interest in collateral eligible pursuant to one or more of the following categories:
Fully disbursed, whole first mortgages on improved residential property (not more than 90 days delinquent), or securities representing a whole interest in such mortgages.

definitions.definition: shall have the meanings given those terms by regulation of the Director

citations.quote: the terms "small business", "agriculture", "small farm", "small agri-business", and "community development activities" shall have the meanings given those terms by regulation of the Director.

notes: Scope limitation applied: this item (12 U.S.C. 1430) contains extensive material on the Affordable Housing Program, community investment cash advance programs, and public-use mortgage databases (subsecs. (g), (i), (j), (k)) that does not bear on discount-window/FHLB interoperability, stigma, or liquidity-reporting timing for fast-moving bank runs; that material was excluded as outside the ratified scope. Retained material (subsecs. (a)-(e), (h)) concerns FHLB collateral eligibility, advance mechanics, security-interest priority, and special liquidity advances, which are directly relevant to mapping FHLB collateral/operational rules against Federal Reserve discount-window rules. FIDELITY NOTES: (1) Text uses 'shall have power to' phrasing (subsecs. (b), (d)) which is permissive/authorizing in substance; extracted as modality 'may' per the text's own grant-of-power framing rather than harmonizing to 'must' -- flagged as an interpretive judgment, not a resolution of ambiguity. (2) Subsection (h)(1) still refers to the 'Director of the Office of Thrift Supervision,' an office abolished by the Dodd-Frank Act (2010); the statutory text as codified has not been updated and is extracted as written, preserving the inconsistency rather than modernizing it. (3) The statute's own footnote states no subsection (f) has been enacted -- lettering gap preserved as-is, not corrected. (4) Subsection (a)(2)'s 'may only be made for the purposes of' was extracted as modality 'conditional' (a restrictive permission) rather than forcing it into must/must_not, since the text's own phrasing is a conditioned permission, not a flat prohibition or command.
